description:
Run multiple reports in a single request.

⚠️ TOKEN OPTIMIZATION: Can return LARGE amounts of data.
Limit to 2-5 reports per batch. Each report should have small limits.

propertyId.description: GA4 property ID to query (overrides the default GA_PROPERTY_ID). Accepts "123456789" or "properties/123456789". Use ga_get_account_summaries to discover IDs.

requests.description: Array of report requests (same format as ga_run_report)

name: ga_batch_run_reports
